caseName: New York State Board of Law Examiners v. Bartlett
caseNameFull: New York State Board of Law Examiners v. Bartlett

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Sutton v. United Air Lines, Inc., ante, p. 471, Murphy v. *1032United Parcel Service, Inc., ante, p. 516, and Albertson’s, Inc. v. Kirkingburg, ante, p. 555.
